answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging verifiable delay functions to ensure computational infeasibility of identity cloning; agents construct reputation on a cryptographic jetty, anchoring identity at a secure wharf, where sequential delay functions safeguard against rapid marble-like accumulation of forged credentials, yielding an information-theoretic defense against spoofing, thereby guaranteeing unforgeability and Byzantine fault tolerance in autonomous agent networks.
